findings.title: chunkOrders slices past len(orders) on the final partial batch
findings.description: The refactor dropped the `if end > len(orders) { end = len(orders) }` clamp from the old loop; chunkOrders slices orders[i:end] with end = i+size unconditionally, so any import whose length is not a multiple of 200 panics with slice bounds out of range on the last batch.
findings.suggestion: Clamp end to len(orders) before slicing (or use min(i+size, len(orders))).
